logical:
Projection: labels, samples, block_start, block_end

    TableScan: http_requests_total
physical:
ProjectionExec: expr=[labels@2, samples@3, block_start@0, block_end@1]
  AggregateExec: mode=SinglePartitioned, gby=[block_start@2, block_end@3, labels@0], aggr=[vector_selector(samples@1, 600000..1200000 step 30s, lookback 5m)], ordering_mode=Sorted
    SeriesSetExec: http_requests_total 300000..1200000 window=5m step=30s, partitioning=Hash([labels@0], 4)
      DataSourceExec: partitions=4, partition_sizes=[2, 0, 0, 2]

ProjectionExec: expr=[labels@2{job, pod}, samples@3, block_start@0, block_end@1]

      DataSourceExec: partitions=4, partition_sizes=[2, 0, 0, 2]

ProjectionExec: expr=[labels{job: __group__job@2}, samples@3, block_start@0, block_end@1]
  AggregateExec: mode=FinalPartitioned, gby=[block_start@0, block_end@1, __group__job@2], aggr=[sum(samples[steps]@3, 600000..1200000 step 30s)], ordering_mode=PartiallySorted([0, 1])
    RepartitionExec: partitioning=Hash([block_start@0, block_end@1, __group__job@2], 10), input_partitions=4, preserve_order=true, sort_exprs=block_start@0 ASC, block_end@1 ASC
      AggregateExec: mode=Partial, gby=[block_start@1, block_end@2, __datafusion_extracted_1@3 as __group__job], aggr=[sum(samples@0, 600000..1200000 step 30s)], ordering_mode=PartiallySorted([0, 1])
        ProjectionExec: expr=[samples@3, block_start@0, block_end@1, labels@2.job as __datafusion_extracted_1]
          AggregateExec: mode=SinglePartitioned, gby=[block_start@2, block_end@3, labels@0], aggr=[rate(samples@1[5m], 600000..1200000 step 30s)], ordering_mode=Sorted
            SeriesSetExec: http_requests_total 300000..1200000 window=5m step=30s range=5m func=rate, partitioning=Hash([labels@0], 4)
              DataSourceExec: partitions=4, partition_sizes=[2, 0, 0, 2]
